summary: Iteration 16 — Tested delete API + RBAC + appointment-location-follows-project. Backend: 9/10 tests pass. Frontend UI test-ids and behaviors all correctly wired (delete buttons on lead/customer/project pages, blocker dialog with 6 blockers on demo project, appointment dialog now shows lead-appt-project and prefills lead-appt-location as 'Kantor pemasaran <ProjectName> — <location>' instead of hardcoded 'Cluster Asri'). CRITICAL BUG FOUND: the DB-persisted RBAC matrix (used by require_permission) was NOT migrated after DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS gained `delete` for projects/units (project_manager) and customers (sales_manager). As a result, PM users get 403 deleting projects/units and sales_manager users get 403 deleting customers, even though DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS/rbac_matrix.py lists them. Leads (sales_manager delete) is fine because that entry was already persisted previously.

critical.issue: Persisted (effective) RBAC matrix missing `delete` for projects/units (project_manager) and customers (sales_manager). Direct API check confirmed: PM DELETE project -> 403; sales_manager DELETE customer -> 403. `defaults` block in response contains delete but `matrix`/`effective` doesn't. Root cause: DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS was updated in code but the stored rbac_matrix in Mongo was not migrated. Leads delete works because sales_manager:leads:delete was already persisted.

action_items: MIGRATE the persisted RBAC matrix in MongoDB: add `delete` to projects.project_manager, units.project_manager, customers.sales_manager. Options: (a) idempotent migration in startup that merges DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS into the stored matrix for missing (resource, role, action) tuples; (b) admin script; (c) reset stored matrix if safe. After migrating, re-run test_iter16_delete_rbac.py::TestPermissionsMatrix and verify PM can DELETE /api/projects/{id} and sales_manager can DELETE /api/customers/{id}.
Update review-request docs: demo project is 'Cluster Asri Blok A' (not 'Harmony Land 5'); no impact on code.
critical_code_review_comments: The rbac_matrix system supports overrides via DB but has no migration when defaults grow. Any new resource/action added to DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS silently does NOT take effect for existing tenants — this is a systemic footgun. Recommend a startup routine that unions missing role→action grants from DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS into stored matrix (idempotent).
AppointmentDialog fix is clean; frontend/src/components/sales/AppointmentDialog.js line 15 builds `Kantor pemasaran ${p.name}${p.location ? ' — '+p.location : ''}` correctly.

rca of the issue: Backend/rbac_matrix.py::DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS was extended to grant `delete` to project_manager for projects/units and sales_manager for customers. However `require_permission` reads the *stored* matrix (admin_router.get_permissions returns `matrix` from `await get_matrix()` and `effective` derived from it). The stored matrix in Mongo was seeded previously without those `delete` entries, and there is no startup merge/migration that unions new DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS grants into the stored matrix, so the new grants never take effect. Reproduction: login pm@sipro.co.id, DELETE /api/projects/{id} (project where pm is member) -> 403; login manager@sipro.co.id, DELETE /api/customers/{fresh_id} -> 403. Mitigation: add a startup step that, for each (resource, role, action) in DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS not already in stored matrix, appends it; run once per boot (idempotent). Alternatively, provide an admin 'reset defaults' or migration script.
